usageNotes: Use this to discover which storage/network scan methods are available on a given node before calling a specific scan sub-endpoint (e.g., scan/nfs, scan/iscsi, scan/zfs). The node must be online and reachable by the cluster; calling against an offline node returns an error. No special privilege is required — any authenticated user can list scan methods.

examples.summary: List available scan methods on node pve1

tips: The returned 'method' values map directly to child paths under /nodes/{node}/scan/ — use them to enumerate which subsequent scan calls are valid.
This is a discovery/index endpoint; it returns method names only, not scan results. Follow up with the appropriate scan sub-endpoint (e.g., get_nodes_node_scan_nfs) to retrieve actual data.
